## b19fa2726c36

**Reproduced defect — advertised semantic controls are ignored.** The audited source is exactly SHA-256 `04ec94fc42cffc4e75c692f94a3b4724507318af4e2eff2b45833e7a72c5d498`, matching `AUDIT_ASSIGNMENT.json`. Its `AXES` table advertises `anchor_corner`, `asymmetry_force`, `palette_kind`, and helpful `texture` choices, but `generate` never draws or branches on those values (except degenerate texture names).

`checks/audit/b19fa2726c36/reproduce_ignored_axes.py` compares both ends of each advertised non-grid control for easy, default, and hard examples. All 12/12 paired outputs are byte-identical, both sides pass `self_check`, and an unknown override key is silently accepted. The source-bound receipt is `checks/audit/b19fa2726c36/ignored_axes_counterexample.json`. This is an axis-honesty defect: curriculum code can believe it varied placement/asymmetry/palette while receiving the same scene.

The official override stage independently fails (`checks/audit/b19fa2726c36-override-run1/checks/b19fa2726c36_audit_override_results.json`), and the combined audit also reports no semantic contract (`checks/audit/b19fa2726c36-run1/checks/b19fa2726c36_audit_semantic_gate.log`). The generator source was not changed.
